name: w1
prompt: Design the final pedal steel guitar plugin UI for Northern Valley Audio. Image 1 = Joshua's original favourite: copy its TOP BAR SYMMETRY (serif 'Pedal Steel' wordmark left with a hairline rule, NORTHERN VALLEY AUDIO spaced caps centred above, preset display DEAD CENTRE, OUTPUT meter + TRIM 0.0 dB right) and its taste (cream bakelite knobs with tick scales and fluted GLIDE/SWELL knobs, black knurled ECHO/REVERB knobs, cream print on black, thin outlined value pills, warm parchment cream, no orange). Everything must feel like one cohesive, symmetrical, unified design, nothing floating in odd spots. Image 3 = the instrument's TRUE proportions and 3D three-quarter perspective (long and slim, legs, pedal rack, knee levers, contact shadow on the carpet; keyhead LEFT, changer RIGHT). Matte panels, legible from across a room, premium, uncluttered. 1600x1000, ultra-realistic. Variation: faithful synthesis; the deck is a black panel with cream print framed by a slim walnut trim. Generate 2 images.
